When it comes to #Dogecoin, the basic & simple question:

What is it?

Dogecoin is the peer-to-peer, open-source cryptocurrency.

Its logo is the Shiba Inu, a Japanese dog breed. 

It is based on Litecoin & uses the same proof-of-work tech

It was launched in 2013

🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🚀🚀🚀

#Dogecoin developers & its community have stated the utility of the currency:
1. It’s used as money for tipping & donation 
2. Online retailers accept it as payment
3. The coins store value
4. Development is continuing. 

Utility/purpose is key 🔑
